jan01.title: Rohit Babu — First Introduction
jan01.scope: Only Rohit's first office introduction. No body-gaze first-show scene, no deliberate test and no next-day follow-up on Jan01.

beats.heading: Aishwarya cliff handoff
beats.plot: Aishwarya questions the changed outfit and private meeting. Ankita sidesteps without resolving the question, closes the upper two buttons and returns to her normal professional presentation. This is before Rohit's arrival.

beats.heading: Junior IT helper enters
beats.plot: Rohit (22), the office IT support junior, arrives to collect the finalized meeting AV/equipment kit. He is diligent, courteous and a little informal with Ankita. No invented months-long household closeness or family tie.

beats.heading: Nickname and friendliness
beats.plot: Ankita playfully calls him 'Rohit Babu' for the first time in this plan; he reacts to the unfamiliar nickname. Establish warm senior-junior familiarity through ordinary equipment handover and jokes.

beats.heading: Incomplete handover hook
beats.plot: A signature/USB-C adapter or inventory item remains pending and Rohit promises to sort it on the next office day. The unresolved task motivates his Jan02 return. Do not add an accidental first look, stunned reaction, cleavage scene or private beauty test to Jan01.

beats.heading: Scene cut
beats.plot: Rohit leaves; Ankita remains normally dressed with buttons fastened. Scene ends without the Dhika EP04 'first show' being compressed into his introduction.

jan02.title: Rohit Babu — First Accidental Look, then the First Deliberate Show
jan02.wardrobeProposal: New office-day front-button cream/neutral kurti with a draped dupatta/scarf and formal trousers. Do not assert this is exactly Jan01 attire or specify an unapproved change. A lightweight scarf serves the same practical role as Dhika's dupatta, not a sudden wardrobe switch on Jan01.

segments.heading: First return — work reason
segments.plot: Rohit returns for the previous day's incomplete support handover or signature. Ankita is occupied sorting equipment and files; she knows his name and jokes with him as 'Rohit Babu'. Keep the warm, ordinary senior-junior familiarity.

segments.heading: Accidental first look
segments.plot: Ankita sets aside her dupatta/scarf to handle the equipment, then leans down to retrieve a needed item. Her outfit shifts naturally. Rohit unexpectedly notices her open neckline and falls silent. Ankita notices his stunned pause, but does not know exactly what he saw; neither has pre-planned this moment.

segments.heading: Interrupted departure and missing confirmation
segments.plot: Rohit gets flustered, gives a hurried practical reply and leaves without completing a pending acknowledgment. Ankita later spots the omission and wonders why he went quiet, maintaining uncertainty rather than immediately concluding what he saw.

segments.heading: Second visit on the same Jan02 — extended conversation
segments.plot: Later on Jan02, Rohit returns to finish the acknowledgment. Use a separate natural office break for time to talk: his work and family obligations, Ankita's supportive mentorship, a friendly drink/snack if appropriate. Preserve the extended rapport before changing into flirtatious tension; no household lunch or child copied from Dhika.

segments.heading: First direct compliment
segments.plot: Rohit spontaneously tells Ankita that her dress or appearance looks lovely. Distinguish unpracticed sincere compliment from Bhalla–Sandeep's more experienced teasing. Ankita notices for the first time that Rohit might view her as an attractive adult woman as well as a team lead.

segments.heading: Independent mirror and self-questioning
segments.plot: After Rohit steps away briefly, Ankita privately considers both his surprised silence and his compliment. The morning/previous-day flattery returns to mind. She wonders how much he actually noticed and whether his shy reaction was genuine, without pretending this is her first-ever beauty test.

segments.heading: Ankita-initiated first show
segments.plot: Ankita consciously chooses to let her otherwise professional outfit sit more loosely for a brief second, and plays with posture and eye contact as Rohit returns. She watches for his reaction rather than scripting it for him. This is separate from the accidental glimpse and happens the same day after the compliment; the first show is non-graphic plot direction.

segments.heading: Reaction and unresolved closing
segments.plot: Rohit is visibly distracted and has difficulty completing an ordinary sentence; Ankita catches his eyes and realizes she successfully affected his composure. He makes a polite excuse and leaves. Alone, Ankita processes her own surprising confidence, unresolved curiosity and the contrast with her senior colleagues. Don't end the whole Dhika EP04 arc or absorb other unapproved scenes.
